body:
## New Features
- Added `/rewind` to restore an earlier conversation turn without leaving the session.
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed Vim input losing the draft after leaving scrollback.
- Fixed telemetry initialization only when telemetry is disabled.
- Fixed MCP OAuth refresh for an enabled server.
- Windows: Fixed drive-letter completion.
## Detailed Changelog
- Fix Vim draft loss after scrollback.
- Reduced startup allocations.

## Breaking Changes
- Removed `features.memories`; users who explicitly enable it must migrate to `features.memory_v2`.
- Removed `sandbox_legacy`; users with an old `legacy_access` permission rule must replace that rule.
## New Features
- Renamed helpers to subagents; existing helper sessions resume as subagent sessions.
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed PreToolUse hook allow decisions bypassing an ask rule.
- Fixed subagents reconnecting when the multi_agent feature is enabled.

## New Features
- Introduced helpers for parallel review.
